representations.name: two-parameter roughness-padding budget
representations.new_information: separates the starting rough-prime exponent 1/2-epsilon from the path-length fraction epsilon/4
representations.first_test: prove rough parts use at most (1-epsilon)K exponent units while shore balancing costs O(1/epsilon)

representations.name: moving epsilon reserve comparator
representations.new_information: tracks the ratio between the epsilon K padding reserve and the 1/epsilon balancing loss
representations.first_test: test epsilon K tending to infinity against the sharper necessary reserve epsilon^2 K tending to infinity

representations.name: square-root rough-prime barrier
representations.new_information: compares internal products of two edge primes with the ambient bound N
representations.first_test: start both incident edge primes above N^(1/2) and check whether any internal path vertex can remain at most N

representations.name: all-zero adaptive query transcript
representations.new_information: retains only primes actually queried after repeated valuation-zero answers and ignores arbitrary off-zero branches
representations.first_test: show every integer coprime to the transcript primes reaches one common terminal leaf

representations.name: transcript cylinder population
representations.new_information: associates a finite input population to one adaptive transcript rather than to a global fixed valuation vector
representations.first_test: lower-bound the zero transcript by N(1-sum 1/p) using only its seedwise queried primes

representations.name: shared-seed mixture of deterministic trees
representations.new_information: conditions on one seed so the adversarial bad relation may depend on the realized uniform classifier
representations.first_test: prove that every successful seed must label its own zero transcript deleted

representations.name: zero-leaf cost indicator
representations.new_information: charges at least delta N-t deletions to the event that the seedwise zero leaf is deleted
representations.first_test: take expectations and derive the exact success-probability bound without independence

representations.name: dense zero-transcript sieve comparator
representations.new_information: allows the queried-prime reciprocal mass to diverge so the all-zero population can have density tending to zero
representations.first_test: delete the complete zero transcript and compare its cost with o(N)

representations.name: padding-prime observation comparator
representations.new_information: lets the zero transcript query the prime used for unequal-shore exponent balancing
representations.first_test: check whether constructed vertices have zero valuation at the padding prime

representations.name: per-integer program comparator
representations.new_information: allows a different hard-coded query tree for every integer and thereby encodes exact labels
representations.first_test: make each program delete one prescribed path vertex and test whether a common zero transcript remains

representations.name: inter-vertex alteration state
representations.new_information: lets later classifications depend on earlier sampled values or on a discovered bad support
representations.first_test: repair the seedwise missed path by one post-classification owner deletion

representations.name: independent per-query randomness comparator
representations.new_information: uses fresh random choices separately for different input integers instead of one shared deterministic tree after conditioning
representations.first_test: check whether one seedwise controlled-prime set can still be extracted for every vertex simultaneously
